submitted.rationale: A coarse scan at Sb = 0.28, 0.52 and 0.72 showed that EQE was highest in the Sb-rich rutile (CrSbO4-type) region. Index 19 (Sb 0.622) gave the highest EQE measured, 0.0336%. A parabola fitted through 0.52, 0.62 and 0.72 has its peak at about 0.622. The neighbour at index 20 (Sb 0.645) was lower at 0.0273%, which supports a peak near index 19.
